description: Aparcamientos en Tàrrega is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by instamaps.cat. Where to park in Tàrrega is a set of geographic information represented in an interactive viewer on an Instamaps map fund. We fiund spatial information related to the parking of vehicles in the city. We can consult the following cartographic files: free parking, public parking and blue zone. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Parking slots in Tàrrega" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Tàrrega, Blue zone, Aparcament gratuït, Free parking, Zona azul, Zona blava. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
